title: Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: WebRender component
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-100781 affects Microsoft software version 4.0, involving a sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: WebRender component. This flaw relates to improper handling of memory boundaries, categorized under CWE-119. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
